sources.title: Mamba-130m-hf Open-source Sequence Modeling Model - Free Deployment for ...
sources.snippet: Mamba is a sequence modeling architecture based on State Space Models (SSM), suitable for causal language modeling tasks. The model provides optimized CUDA kernel implementations, supporting efficient text generation.
